{
 "path": "/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-openclaw-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference/play/users/u091/system/state/workspace/programs/task-29b97f7b.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != 0)
    # The motif is the rare nonzero color; the other nonzero color is the background.
    marker = min(counts, key=counts.get)
    coords = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == marker]
    r0 = min(r for r, c in coords)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in coords)
    shape = [(r-r0, c-c0) for r, c in coords]
    mh = max(r for r, c in shape) + 1
    mw = max(c for r, c in shape) + 1
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for dr in range(h - mh + 1):
        for dc in range(w - mw + 1):
            cells = [(dr + r, dc + c) for r, c in shape]
            if all(grid[r][c] == 0 for r, c in cells):
                for r, c in cells:
                    out[r][c] = marker
    return out
"
}
